title: Audio Lesson: Worktree Isolation
limitations: Generated from concept pages; not yet reviewed.
Content may drift from source; verify against current main.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: When multiple agents work on the same repository, they fight over files. Agent A edits main-dot-py while Agent B reads it. The result: corruption, merge conflicts, or silent data loss. Worktree isolation gives each agent its own working directory.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Git worktrees share the same object store but have independent working directories and index files. Creating a worktree is cheap — no full clone needed. Each task gets a branch named task-slash-task-id for clean isolation.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Instead of sending the full environment to the model every turn, Cogentrex computes deltas. Only changed fields — the branch name changed, a new environment variable appeared — are sent. This saves precious context tokens.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: SYSTEM-dot-MD is auto-generated to describe the runtime: Python version, Node version, operating system, git state. Any agent entering the repository can read this file and immediately understand the execution environment.
